title: Namo Venkatesa
desc: Ramana, a ventriloquist, falls in love with Pooja, the daughter of a rich factionist, while on tour in Europe. When she is forced to marry against her wish, Ramana and her uncle decide to rescue her.

title: Yatra
desc: A renowned Indian politician embarks on a 900-mile walking tour and interacts with his followers as part of his election campaign.

title: Sapthagiri LLB
desc: Sapthagiri, a small-time lawyer, reopens a high-profile case in order to get famous. However, doing so pits him against Sai Kumar, a formidable opponent and one of the best lawyers in the country.

title: M.S. Dhoni: The Untold Story
desc: M S Dhoni, a boy from Ranchi, aspires to play cricket for India. Though he initially tries to please his father by working for the Indian Railways, he ultimately decides to chase his dreams.

title: Super Cowboy
desc: An ordinary watchman, Simhachalam faces accusation of stealing Texas Mullangi, a diamond and before he is hanged, he is saved by few cowboys.
